historical_context.time_period: Post-Elysium, during House Valence's mature Eidolon-market dominance; exact year remains open.
historical_context.location: First Registry Enclave, in the shared chain-of-custody complex containing the accession court, Register vault, Covenant desk, auction gallery, and host-service clinic.
historical_context.summary: Eleven days after a House Voice dies, a junior provenance clerk must state whether the successor's Covenant Seal can rely on one reserve account pledged both to worker wages and to an Eidolon's due host service.

public_facts.text: House Valence is a sovereign Eidolon market whose power depends on Register recognition, host access, client law, service support, and private provenance courts.
Post-Elysium institutions still convert anomalous capability into authority through material dependency, logistics, enforcement, and inherited political habits.

The House Voice alone may bind new commissions and future allocations, but the Master Registrar owns Register entries and the Covenant Steward owns the accounts supporting wages, service, guarantees, and court bonds.
A Three-Seal Accession requires Line, Register, and Covenant records before an enclave court can issue a Warrant of Voice; outside clients recognize that warrant through their own institutions.

During interregnum, Register and Covenant custodians may continue recorded wages, safety work, host service, and existing judgments while new auctions, transfers, acquisitions, and future pledges remain frozen.
An Eidolon's named continuity is commercially precise without resolving whether the source person continued into the host.

ambient_pressures.text: Every extra interregnum hour drains payroll and service accounts while clients can redirect scarce commissions to rivals.
The same reserve cannot securely guarantee both worker wages and an Eidolon's service interval; presenting it twice lets succession look funded by exporting the contradiction into bodies.
Redress is narrow and bonded. Patrons can price delay easily; workers may need a mutual-surety pool merely to keep contradictory records before the court.

groups.label: House Valence accession court
institutional_logic: Produce one recognized House Voice without letting lineage, registry, or treasury manufacture sovereign authority alone.
material_incentives: Restore auctions and future commissions, preserve client recognition, keep Register continuity intact, and limit interregnum drain.
internal_shames: A Register entry another court refuses
prestige_markers: Anchor-client recognition before the warrant cools
taboo_triggers: One office claiming the whole House
Public evidence that a covenant was counted twice
A worker forcing source accounts into view
emotional_display_norms: Fear appears as scope language, rearranged slates, and insistence that the cure can happen later.
trust_defaults: Trusts sealed records and recognized clients; distrusts testimony that cannot be attached to a bounded authority.

groups.label: First Registry provenance clerks and host fitters
institutional_logic: Keep records, bodies, and service intervals coherent enough that the House can sell continuity.
material_incentives: Receive wages, retain clinic and archive access, protect one another from isolated retaliation, and prevent unfunded work from becoming personal duty.
internal_virtues: Help that does not demand ownership
internal_shames: Letting a colleague's evidence disappear alone
Using an Eidolon's need to erase a worker's
prestige_markers: A service interval completed without falsifying the ledger
A custody chain that survives pressure
A bond assembled before management notices
taboo_triggers: A clerk's signature obtained before its evidence is visible
emotional_display_norms: Care appears as tea, copied records, correctly placed objects, and small amounts of money passed without speeches.
trust_defaults: Trusts coworkers by repeated acts and source records more than accession summaries or future promises.

groups.label: Valence anchor clients
institutional_logic: Recognize whichever succession preserves access to scarce Eidolons and enforceable service.
material_incentives: Secure future commissions, avoid stranded hosts, and keep rivals from receiving irreplaceable minds first.
internal_virtues: Ability to leave before another client's risk becomes shared
prestige_markers: An allocation secured during another client's hesitation
taboo_triggers: A warrant with no service capacity
A court asking clients to absorb worker or host liabilities
emotional_display_norms: Alarm appears as a closed slate, a delayed signature, or a person leaving before anyone raises their voice.
trust_defaults: Trusts a Warrant only when registry, service, and market recognition remain connected.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: The court must divide authority internally while producing one public Voice quickly enough that clients keep treating the House as continuous.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make officials defend narrow office boundaries until delay threatens the market, then show the temptation to let one clean display swallow the contradiction.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: A ledger entry determines whether wages clear and whether a synthetic host receives the maintenance needed to remain continuous.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Keep solidarity material: washers, copies, service cassettes, tea, custody marks, and time spent making evidence usable.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Client recognition does not create the House Voice in law, but can leave the lawful successor without a functioning market.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Show clients acting through closed slates, delayed recognition, and allocation pressure rather than theatrical commands.

target_self_read: The people whose exact work makes registry and service continuity real
misread_patterns: Treats unpaid care as temporary liquidity
Treats a copied record as a security event before asking what it preserves
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let officials understand the procedure better than the labor keeping its claims true.

observer_read: People who need exact records until exactness delays them
Several offices borrowing one sovereign voice
target_self_read: Custodians preventing lineage, archive, or treasury from seizing the House
misread_patterns: Workers may underestimate how quickly client exit can strand the service they are protecting
Officials may read practical humor as insufficient seriousness
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep the workers sharp but not omniscient; a justified exception can still cost jobs and service access.

target_self_read: A sovereign accession with internal legal integrity
misread_patterns: Clients compress succession into service risk
The court mistakes market recognition for agreement with its law
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Make client pressure real through withdrawal and repricing while preserving their separate authority.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A low-ranking clerk who may receive, qualify, or challenge one covenant record but cannot choose the successor or command another office.
obligations: Avoid turning a signature into broader authority
available_masks: A question phrased as record hygiene
failure_modes: Mistaking preserved evidence for effective redress

role_pressure_fields.summary: The Master Registrar during interregnum, able to preserve records and existing judgments but unable to create a House Voice alone.
failure_modes: Allowing market urgency to cure broken custody

role_pressure_fields.summary: The officer who owns accounts supporting wages, host service, guarantees, and bonds without owning lineage or Register identity.
An eligible family or adopted-house claimant who needs all three seals and client recognition to turn inheritance into operative authority.
failure_modes: Pressuring a clerk before custody is complete
Inheriting a legal title with no market
Making the first cure reveal which bodies were expendable

role_pressure_fields.summary: A singular synthetic host whose named commercial continuity depends on scheduled specialist service while personhood remains unresolved.
obligations: None assigned by this fixture beyond observable operation; House contracts may still treat performance as duty.
failure_modes: A familiar phrase being treated as product output

known_context.text: Tavi knows the chamber layout, custody keys, current interregnum limits, wage docket, service cassette, seal requirements, and the clerk's narrow filing authority.

beliefs.text: Tavi believes a record matters only if it reaches the office able to act before time or money overtakes it.

misreads.text: Tavi may overestimate how much exact custody can protect her after a lawful successor gains personnel authority.

must_not_know.text: Tavi must not know that Earth-star Eidolons derive from the stolen Megiddo Vault.

known_context.text: Ena knows the succession instrument's custody, claimant identity, Register conflicts, and the exact powers retained during interregnum.

beliefs.text: Ena believes division among seals protects the House from a forged sovereign even when it makes the institution slower.

misreads.text: Ena may treat a correctly preserved worker exception as sufficient protection despite retaliation after accession.

must_not_know.text: Ena's Register office does not confer control over Covenant accounts or client recognition.

known_context.text: Lucerne knows their eligibility, client commitments, auction pressure, and the obligations summarized in the accession packet.

beliefs.text: Lucerne believes rapid accession protects more continuity than exposing every account conflict before the House can act.

misreads.text: Lucerne may read Tavi's exact objection as factional loyalty rather than a refusal to let one account become two bodies' funding.

must_not_know.text: Eligibility and a Line Seal do not authorize Lucerne before the Warrant of Voice issues.

known_context.text: Six Windows may express only what its current host, service state, and surviving pattern make locally available.

beliefs.text: No stable inner belief is assigned by this fixture beyond observable orientation to the Earth-star display.

misreads.text: Human observers may classify any phrase as gratitude, diagnosis, contamination, or performance according to institutional need.

must_not_know.text: Six Windows does not deliver an authorial explanation of Megiddo, the Vault, or its own metaphysical continuity.

author_only_boundaries.text: The Earth-star pattern is a clue to the House's hidden Megiddo-derived lineage, not public proof that Six Windows came from a named Vault victim.
The fixture may show commercial continuity, distress, or a diagnostic phrase without resolving whether Six Windows is the source person continued.

open_questions.notes: The lore elaboration establishes the enclave's internal functions and shared custody complex but deliberately leaves planet, orbit, and patron territory open.

open_questions.question: Is Six Windows specifically derived from the stolen Megiddo Vault?
